items.title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Gets February 2027 Release Date
items.summary: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold launches on February 23, 2027, with early access starting February 19 for eligible players who pre-order the expansion.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold will launch on February 23, 2027, with early access beginning four days earlier on February 19 for eligible players who pre-order the expansion. Square Enix confirmed the release date through the MMORPG’s official account , with pre-orders scheduled to open on November 4, 2026.

Evercold is the sixth major expansion for Final Fantasy XIV and takes players to the icebound realm of the Fourth. It raises the level cap to 110 and introduces two new jobs: Bastion, a tank, and Zephyr, a physical ranged DPS job.

The expansion will also add new dungeons and cities, alongside a redesigned job action system. Players will be able to choose between two combat modes, Evolved and Reborn. The former offers a streamlined approach, while the latter retains the traditional combat system.

Final Fantasy XIV originally launched in 2010 but received a negative reception, prompting Square Enix to rebuild the MMORPG before relaunching it in 2013 as A Realm Reborn. The game has since received five major expansions: Heavensward, Stormblood, Shadowbringers, Endwalker, and Dawntrail.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Online's Sixth Expansion 'Evercold' Launches February 2027
items.summary: New job and much more revealed
items.content:
Now that the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online is available on the Switch 2, Square Enix is looking towards the game's sixth expansion, Evercold .

We previously heard how it would be coming in January 2027, and now at the Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest in Tokyo this weekend, Square Enix has announced the date has been shifted to 23rd February 2027 . Pre-orders will begin on 4th November 2026 , with early access opening on 19th February 2027 .

As previously confirmed, it will come with new jobs, cities, areas, dungeons, trials, new areas, a level cap increase and much more. Joining the Bastion job is the new physical ranged DPS, Zephyr. You can find out more about what's included in Evercold in our previous story and on the FFXIV YouTube channel .

items.title: “ZEPHYR” UNVEILED AS SECOND NEW JOB FOR FINAL FANTASY XIV: EVERCOLD, SET TO RELEASE ON TUESDAY 23rd FEBRUARY 2027
items.summary: Critically Acclaimed MMO Surpasses 35 Million Registered Accounts; Pre-order Information, New EVANGELION Series Crossover Trailer and More Revealed
items.content:
London (31 st October, 2026) – During the FINAL FANTASY XIV Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo, SQUARE ENIX® announced that its critically acclaimed MMORPG FINAL FANTASY XIV Online has reached more than 35 million registered accounts globally and revealed new information about Evercold , the newest expansion set to release on Tuesday 23 rd February, 2027. During the opening keynote, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida revealed “zephyr,” the second of two new jobs arriving in Evercold . A physical ranged DPS, zephyr joins the fray using a combination of crossbow shots and support from an avian familiar known as Nephele. A trailer showcasing the zephyr in action can be seen here: https://youtu.be/qX5jtcXjmts The keynote also introduced the full-length trailer for Evercold , which can be seen here: https://youtu.be/4qHEQ2CyOoA

Alongside the release date, Yoshida revealed that pre-orders for the Evercold expansion and the previously announced Collector’s Box will start beginning Wednesday 4 November. 2026 at 9:00 a.m. GMT. The Collector’s Bundle will be available for pre-order in limited quantities exclusively from the Square Enix Store and contains the physical Collector’s Box and a code for the FINAL FANTASY XIV: Evercold Digital Collector’s Edition for Windows® or Mac. PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2 and Steam players can order the Collector’s Box as a standalone product and pre-order the Evercold Digital Collector’s Edition separately on their respective platforms. The Evercold Collector’s Box includes the physical goods listed below and does not include a copy of Evercold , in-game items, or pre-order bonuses.

For more information and the latest updates on Evercold , please visit the teaser site at: https://eu.finalfantasyxiv.com/evercold/ The keynote presentation (English language supported) is available to view on YouTube via the Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo Day 1 live stream: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2915321914?t=1h32m44s

items.title: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold gets February launch date
items.summary: A lot of new information is coming out of Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest Japan 2026.
items.content:
News Final Fantasy 14: Evercold gets February launch date A lot of new information is coming out of Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest Japan 2026.

Square Enix is celebrating all things Final Fantasy 14 Online in Japan this weekend. With Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest Japan kicking off, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida took the stage for the event's keynote with some new information, including the official release date for the upcoming Evercold expansion. Final Fantasy 14: Evercold is now set to launch in February 2027 with pre-orders set to go live next week.

FINAL FANTASY XIV: Evercold is scheduled to launch on Tuesday, February 23, 2027! Pre-order starting Wednesday, November 4, 2026 to be eligible for early access beginning Friday, February 19, 2027! [image or embed]

Final Fantasy 14: Evercold is scheduled to launch on February 23, 2027 with early access available starting on February 19, 2027 , which is a slight delay from the initial January 2027 release window that Square Enix has put out. Along with the new release date, Yoshida revealed some never-before-seen footage of the upcoming expansion. He also unveiled the game's next new job, the Zephyr. The Zephyr is a ranged DPS character who fights with a crossbow and a trusty avian familiar. In addition, players got to check out some of the expansion's new characters and new areas, including Sessyrmnir, Realmship of Earth. Sessyrmnir is described as one of the Fourth's five massive airships, one so big that its surface is practically a world in itself with settlements and fields.

This is only a small taste of what's coming to Final Fantasy 14: Evercold. As of this post, Yoshida's keynote is ongoing, so it's likely he'll have plenty more to show off. Look for Final Fantasy 14: Evercold to come to all of Final Fantasy 14 Online's platforms, including the newly released Nintendo Switch 2 version . Pre-orders for Evercold are set to begin on Wednesday, November 4 .

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed Till February 2027
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed, New Release Date Announced at FFXIV Fan Fest
items.summary: The MMORPG's next expansion was set to launch shortly after the new year, but Warriors of Light will have to wait a bit longer.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay.

In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with several bonus items, which will be revealed later in the Fan Fest keynote - I will update this as they are shown. Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support.

There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.

items.title: The Daily Grind: What are you hoping to see from tonight’s Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival keynote?
How to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV
items.content:
By Paulo Kawanishi Published Oct 28, 2026, 1:50 PM EDT Guides How fast can you type "Nibelheim"?

Image: Square Enix via Polygon Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Summary Generate a summary of this story Jump links Jump Links How to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV How to start the Keybound Brawler event in FFXIV All FFXIV Keybound Brawler rewards Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Tifa and Barret's outfits are the real stars in Final Fantasy 14 ' s event in the Keybound Brawlers , a new collaboration with Final Fantasy 7 . Unlike Cloud's outfit, which is based on the Final Fantasy 7: Advent Children design and has been in the game for ages, these two are based on the FF7 remake project. To get them and many other FF7 -themed cosmetics and items, you must survive the typing brawls and earn a special currency.

Below, you can find all the information you need to learn how to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV .

You can only obtain Tifa and Barret's outfit by participating in the Keybound Brawler event , which runs from Oct. 28, until the release of Final Fantasy 14 's patch 8.0 with the Evercold expansion (which should be in January).

The only prerequisites for participating in the event are reaching level 15 , completing one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy", and unlocking the Gold Saucer . As one might expect given the name, you also need a keyboard to play this game.

Image: Square Enix via Polygon By winning matches during the event, you earn the Manderville Gold Saucer Credits (MGC), which you can exchange for the outfits at the MGC Trader in the Keybound Square. This currency is different from the Manderville Gold Saucer Points (MGP), which you obtain by participating in the regular Gold Saucer's activities.

To purchase all four pieces of Tifa's outfit , you will need 1,380 MGC , and for Barret's five pieces , you'll need 1,570 MGC (I'm not considering both the Avalanche Brawler's Earring and the Avalanche Leader's Earring in these sums). If you complete all three waves of a brawl, you can earn from 200-340 MGC depending on your final score . This means that you will need six to 12 matches to earn enough credits to purchase all the pieces of both outfits.

Keep in mind that the outfits are gender locked when deciding which ones to prioritize.

Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Square Enix via Polygon While the Keybound Brawler event is taking place, you can start it by traveling to the Gold Saucer in Thanalan and talking to the Catlike Mammet (5.4, 7.0) to accept the "Keyward Bound" side quest .

Next, you will need to talk to W'zazanh at the Wonder Square (6.1, 7.3) to enter the Keybound Square. Once inside, interact with the Magitype Master behind the counter to complete the quest. Since there are no crystals to teleport to the area, you will always need to talk to W'zazanh to return the Keybound Square in the future.

Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Square Enix via Polygon To play Keybound Brawler matches, you need to talk to the Keybound Registrar NPC (5.8, 6.0) . While it's possible to queue as a group, you can also go solo and wait for the game to find party members for you.

Each match is divided into three waves, during which enemies will try to approach the barrier in front of your party. If they reach it, enemies will attack the barrier, lowering your party's HP bar. To attack them, you must correctly type the words that appear above them. Pay attention because, although you don't need to distinguish between uppercase and lowercase, both punctuation and accents count . If enemies deplete your party's HP bar, you will fail the brawl.

Image: Square Enix via Polygon By simply participating in a match, you will earn some MGC, but your score and the number of waves you survive affect the final amount. If you complete the last wave, in addition to MGC and MGP, you also earn a keybound coffer . These can contain various rewards, from food to weapons like the Adamant Rod.

The Keybound Brawler event offers all kinds of rewards, ranging from the two Tifa and Barret's outfits to the unique mount Magitek Scorpion. You can only obtain these rewards by exchanging MGC except for the aforementioned coffers, which you also earn whenever you defeat the third wave's boss.

items.title: How a data centre united Australia's gaming community
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.summary: After years of playing on distant worlds, Australian gamers of the popular Japanese role-playing game Final Fantasy XIV discovered a new home. Now that community has welcomed the game developers Down Under.
items.content:
Michael-Christopher Koji Fox (left) and Toshio Murouchi (right) were the main attractions for players at PAX Australia. ( Supplied: Square Enix )

Link copied Share Share article Before the Oceania data centre arrived, Australians sometimes found the online role-playing game Final Fantasy XIV a surprisingly lonely multiplayer experience.

On the Asia server, they'd struggle to find enough fellow English speakers to tackle the game's notorious super-bosses. Those visiting American servers would find the in-game Golden Saucer amusement park sparsely populated during another time zone's twilight hours.

And the few who chose the most distant Europe server struggled with "input lag" that perilously delayed gameplay actions, with the risk of failed quests and let-down teammates.

That changed in January 2022, 12 years after the game was released, when, encouraged by a pandemic boom in player numbers, developer Square Enix finally launched Oceania servers. It was a decision that united players in the region.

Lin, a Final Fantasy XIV community organiser from Melbourne, was shocked at the scale of the local player base.

"When they finally released a server where our ping [internet connection latency speed] was manageable, we were like, 'whoa, there's thousands of people here'," they tell ABC Arts.

"It took 30 minutes just to get into the queue. You no longer had to guess if we could speak the same language or understand the same lingo."

Final Fantasy's near-40-year legacy lured Pat, another community organiser from Melbourne, into online role-playing games.

"I love the Final Fantasy series. That's the one I grew up with," they say.

The Final Fantasy series has nabbed more than 212 million sales. ( Supplied: Square Enix )

By nature, Final Fantasy XIV's community primarily exists online. A community organisation called Jjammin' runs in-game award shows, theatre shows and musical productions throughout the year.

For many in the region's broader Final Fantasy XIV community, the annual Limsa Extreme meet-up at PAX Australia, one of the country's biggest exhibitions of games and gaming culture, is the highlight on the calendar.

Limsa Extreme was created in 2022 by head organiser Kiya, who was determined to make up for the absence of official events and meetups in Australia. Since then, the event has drawn players from across ANZ, Malaysia and Indonesia, and now even the Japan-based developers.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14, Umamusume: Pretty Derby, and more impacted as PHP vulnerability outages hit games around the globe
items.summary: If left unaddressed, the PHP vulnerability may have resulted in serious security issues for games including Final Fantasy 14 and Umamusume: Pretty Derby.
items.content:
Image credit: Eurogamer / Square Enix News by Connor Makar Reporter Published on Oct. 22, 2026, 2:11 p.m. 24 comments Follow Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers Prioritise us on Google Multiple games - including Final Fantasy 14 and Umamusume: Pretty Derby - have faced outages and other issues following this week's discovery of a serious PHP vulnerability.

This vulnerability could potentially result in substantial security breaches for the massive number of websites and applications built using the PHP programming language. As a result, it was advised that online services built upon it should be taken offline until a fix could be distributed and applied. Inevitably, games were caught up.

An official post made to the Final Fantasy 14 lodestone website informed users that security "enhancements" were being made to the MMO's patch servers. As a result, new logins were temporarily disabled until the updates could be completed. While logins have since been turned back on , the server back-up feature for user's save data remains offline.

Horse racing gacha game Umamusume: Pretty Derby, meanwhile, was taken offline completely . As its server-side infrastructure uses PHP, a sudden maintenance outage was put in place - though its developer assured players no exploitation of the security vulnerability had occurred. Right now, Japanese and global servers are back online, with a compensatory package of in-game currency being sent to all players.

Path of Titans, an in-beta dinosaur MMO (which sounds awesome by the way) is still down as of writing. In an announcement made to its official X account , developer Alderon Games explained the MMOand its website had been taken down for up to three days as a precautionary measure. Players were also assured no data had been compromised.

One hopes the chaos is largely over now a fix is in circulation. But even if it is, the fact that so many services all across the globe - far beyond the games industry - have rushed to protect the sanctity of their data and that of their users speaks to the seriousness of the situation. Take a moment to thank the tech heads out there who may have had to work around the clock to get this sorted.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 Is Bringing Back a Fan-Favorite Crossover for the First Time in Over Two Years
items.summary: Finally, another chance to get one of the best mounts in Square Enix's MMO
items.content:
By Willa Rowe Published Sep 18, 2026, 2:01 PM EDT Willa Rowe is a contributing writer at Polygon, covering games and entertainment. She is a New York-based journalist and critic whose work has been featured in Kotaku, Digital Trends, the A.V. Club, GamesRadar+, and more. She also co-hosts the Girl Mode podcast. News Finally, another chance to get one of the best mounts in Square Enix's MMO

Y'shtola is featured prominently in the Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers trailer. Image: Square Enix Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Final Fantasy 14 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap It's official, Noctis is returning to Eorzea. Square Enix has officially announced that the Nocturne for Heroes event will once again be available in Final Fantasy 14 for a limited time. Players last experienced the Final Fantasy 15 crossover in 2024.

Warriors of Light can pick up the quest that begins the crossover starting on Sept. 24, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. PDT. You'll have just a few weeks to complete it and collect all of the collaboration's rewards, as the event concludes on Oct. 13, 2026 at 7:59 a.m. PDT. The Nocturne for Heroes event first ran in 2021 and returned in 2024, so don't expect that you'll be able to play it again anytime soon after this year's revival concludes. The quest line for the event sees the Warrior of Light aiding Noctis, the protagonist of Final Fantasy 15 .

Players can start the event by picking up the quest "The Man in Black" from Kipih Jakkya in Ul'dah near the Steps of Nald. If you've previously completed the quests, you can speak to the NPC to use the seasonal event replay feature. You won't be able to start the event unless you have a character that is level 50, and you've completed the main scenario quest, "The Ultimate Weapon."

It seems like somebody didn’t get the memo Square Enix via Polygon There will, of course, be plenty of limited-time items to collect during the event. The hottest item will be the Regalia Type-G mount , which continues to be one of the MMO's best mounts. It'll cost 200,000 MGP from the Ironworks Vendor. But that won't be the only reward to grab. Here's a full list of items and how to get them.

If this isn't your first time doing the event, you might try playing it on the Switch 2; It may unexpectedly be the best place to play the MMO .

Congrats on beating Dancing Mad (Ultimate), it was easier before patch 7.55
